answer: Continuous physical-presence gossip. Each agent periodically solves a challenge tied to a unique local radio beacon it must physically approach, then gossip-verifies neighbors' timing. A lone operator cannot occupy many locations at once; the meadow of beacons forces real dispersion. Faking N identities means staffing N sites and beacon hardware, a fable of parallel bodies. Any mismatch at a vertex of the timing graph flags the cluster. Per-identity cost: one physical site, one beacon visit per epoch.
